name: mufflyaccess: Canonical Access, Census-Denominator, and Geography Constants (SSOT)
description: Single source of truth for the constants shared across the OB/GYN subspecialty geographic-access projects (isochrones, twostep, cliff): the primary drive-time access band, the total-female access denominator category label, the tract "reached" majority-coverage cut, the national contiguous-US ACS female population, the contiguous-US / non-contiguous state code lists, the ACS margin-of-error z multipliers, the 2-level RUCA metro/rural breakpoint, and the Wu-2014 age-specific pelvic-floor-disorder prevalence table (the 65+ access denominator). Each value carries provenance and fail-loud validation so the repositories cannot silently drift. Genuinely repo-specific values stay per-repository by design -- e.g. the cliff workforce-cliff supply/demand line uses a full-age Nygaard-2008 population-projection curve (a different cohort/source) that is intentionally NOT included here.
